letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share these moments with you, my forever cutie. Even the gentle breezes of this February whisper your name, and I smile thinking of the laughter we’ve woven into our days. You turn ordinary moments into sparkling memories, and my heart races just at the thought of our next adventure together. Thank you for being my love, my partner, my everything—here’s to countless more beautiful chapters side by side.
poem:
In every sunrise, I see your smile,  
Across the dunes and streets, mile after mile.  
Your laughter dances, a sweet, soft tune,  
Together, love, we’re forever in bloom.
